items.text:
Complete the following statements
11 of 22 points
Complete the following statements by choosing ALL that is applicable from the options below.


Tip: Read the statements slowly and clearly whilst understanding the scenario. Then search for the rule in your notes, confirm it and then respond.

1. حال can be...
*
0/1
...an إسم.
 
...a فعل.
 
...a حرف (directly without being متعلق).
...a مركب غير مفيد like: طالعَ جبلٍ
...a جملة.
 
...a شبه الجملة (جار مجرور - ظرف).
 
...معرفة.
...نكرة.
 
Correct answer
...an إسم.
...a فعل.
...a مركب غير مفيد like: طالعَ جبلٍ
...a جملة.
...a شبه الجملة (جار مجرور - ظرف).
...نكرة.

2. حال is always...
*
1/1
...مجرور.
...منصوب.
 
...مرفوع.

3. حال signifes upon...
*
1/1
...the condition of the subject or object when the action is conducted.
 
...the method an action is conducted in.
...the place an action is conducted in.
...the reason for an action being conducted.

4. According to the Jamhoor, the  حال will generally...
*
0/1
...be in relation to the فاعل.
 
...be in relation to the مضاف إليه.
...be in relation to the مفعول به.
 
...be in relation to the مفعول مطلق.
...be in relation to the مفعول فيه.
...be in relation to the مبتدا.
 
Correct answer
...be in relation to the فاعل.
...be in relation to the مفعول به.
...be in relation to the مضاف إليه.

5. The ذو الحال can be...
*
0/1
...an إسم.
 
...a فعل.
...a حرف.
...a مركب غير مفيد.
...a جملة.
...a شبه الجملة (جار مجرور - ظرف).
...معرفة.
 
...نكرة.
 
Correct answer
...an إسم.
...a مركب غير مفيد.
...معرفة.
...نكرة.

6. The ذو الحال...
*
1/1
...can come after the حال.
 
...must come before the حال.
...must come after the حال.
...can come before the حال.

7. The حال MUST precede the ذو الحال when...
*
1/1
...the خبر precedes the مبتدا.
...the ذو الحال is جمع مؤنث سالم and منصوب.
...the فعل is hidden.
...the ذو الحال is نكرة and منصوب.

8.  The حال...
*
1/1
...can come before the verb.
 
...must come after the verb.
...can come after the verb.
 
...must come before the verb.

9. If the حال is a مفزد, then it can be...
*
0/1
...a صفة مشبهة.
...a شبه الجملة.
 
...an اسم الظرف.
...an اسم الفاعل.
 
...an اسم المبالغة.
 
...an اسم الآلة.
...an اسم المفعول.
...an اسم التفضيل.
...a مصدر.
 
Correct answer
...an اسم الفاعل.
...an اسم المفعول.
...a صفة مشبهة.
...an اسم المبالغة.
...an اسم التفضيل.
...a مصدر.
...a شبه الجملة.

10. The حال and ذو الحال must correlate in...
*
1/1
...(D) Definitenes
...(I) I'raab
...(N) Number
 
...(G) Gender

11. If the ذو الحال is nonsensical plural, the حال...
*
1/1
...will correlate in being plural and feminine or masculine depending on the gender of the nonsensical plural ذو الحال..
...will be plural feminine.
...will be single feminine.
 
...will be single masculine.

12.  If the حال is a جملة, then it must be a...
*
1/1
...جملة إنشائية.
...جملة فعلية خبرية.
 
...جملة إسمية خبرية.

13.  A رابط is brought in a حال when...
*
1/1
...the حال is a جملة.
 
...the حال is a مفرد.

14.  (continuing from Q13) In such a case...
*
0/1
...the حال can contain a رابط.
...the حال must contain a رابط.
 
Correct answer
...the حال can contain a رابط.

16.  A فعل مضارع حال can be preceded by...
*
0/1
...the word لا.
...the word ما.
 
...the word لَمَّا.
 
...the word سوف.
...the word لم.
 
...the word لن.
 
...the letter س.
...the word قد.
 
Correct answer
...the word قد.
...the word لم.
...the word ما.
...the word لا.
...the word لَمَّا.

15.  A فعل مضارع must always contain a رابط...
*
0/1
...except when preceded by لن.
 
...except when preceded by سوف.
...except when preceded by لم.
 
...except when preceded by قد.
 
...except when preceded by لا.
Correct answer
...except when preceded by لم.

17. An إسم جامد can not be a حال unless...
*
0/1
...the اسم جامد is a name.
...the اسم جامد has a مشتق نعت.
...the اسم جامد can be interpreted as a مشتق.
 
...the اسم جامد has a حال aswell.
Correct answer
...the اسم جامد can be interpreted as a مشتق.
...the اسم جامد has a مشتق نعت.

18. The حال and the action preceding it...
*
0/1
...must always correspond in time.
 
...should correspond in time but not always.
...must never correspond in time.
Correct answer
...should correspond in time but not always.

19. When the حال is a فعل ماضي, generally, it has قد preceding it (provided there isn't a reason to prevent قد). The purpose of this قد is to...
*
1/1
...provide a meaning of close past tense (القريب) in order to bring it close to the مضارع verb because the مضارع verb is the closest to an اسم الفاعل which is what حال should be in principle.
 
...provide a meaning of ceirtainty (التحقيق) in order to ascertain the حال so it is absolutely clear and ratified.
...provide a meaning of emphasis (التأكيد) in order to remove doubt since the حال is in the past and it could become doubtful.

20. A فعل ماضي حال is prevented from being preceded by قد...
*
0/1
...when the فعل ماضي comes after إلّا.
...when the فعل ماضي is free from a رابط.
...when the فعل ماضي is free from a واو حالية.
 
...when the فعل ماضي is connected with أو.
Correct answer
...when the فعل ماضي is connected with أو.
...when the فعل ماضي comes after إلّا.

21. A فعل مضارع حال...
*
1/1
...can never be preceded by قد, whether the واو حالية is there or not..
...can be preceded by قد only if the واو حالية is absent.
...can be preceded by قد and the واو حالية will also be necessary.

22. A حال مقدرة is...
*
0/1
...a حال which is in no tense (tenseless, timeless in another dimension) that's why it's called مقدّرة because it's to do with decree (تقدير).
 
...a حال which is in the past tense.
...a حال which is in the future tense.
...a حال which is in the present tense.
Correct answer
...a حال which is in the future tense.

Important instructions

Look at the following sentences. A loose translation has been provided and focus on حال ذوالحال has been ignored on purpose, however, potential حال ذوالحال has been underlined in the sentences.

Considering the rules of واو حالية, workout which construction is a حال and which isn't.
Workout whether the واو حالية is necessary, permissible or prevented then tick the corresponding box.
Explain your answer by breifly detailing your choice. Mention why it can't be a حال if you think it isn't a حال. This could be because a واو حالية is missing where it was necessary or vice versa, amongst other factors. Or mention why it is حال if you think it is حال considering a similar thought process. You will lose a mark if your explanation is not in line with your answer OR if you don't explain your answer properly.
                           Use your notes. Look at them, read them, understand them.
